newsitem.title: CHILE: Codelco El Teniente mine's 1996 output rises.
newsitem.headline: Codelco El Teniente mine's 1996 output rises.

text.p: El Teniente, Chilean state copper giant Codelco's second largest pit, produced 342,800 tonnes of fine copper last year, up from 322,843 tonnes in 1995, a division official told Reuters.
The mine's Caletones smelter processed 374,560 tonnes of copper including all El Teniente's output and 31,760 tonnes of copper concentrates from Codelco's Andina division, he said.
El Teniente's output this year is expected to similar to 1996 levels, he added.
